hypotheses.statement: The scored finite-record transfer at fixed frequency bins on rigid (lossless) rooms is dominated by the nearest discrete cavity poles; pole positions shift with discretization so adjacent-level differences stay O(1) while levels are pre-asymptotic.
PFFDTD run7 self-convergence fails because the voxel-staircased sloped ceiling differs at every PPW, so each level solves a slightly different geometry; poles do not converge monotonically.
The R100B concave coupled p/dt non-monotonicity comes from the GL2/Newmark temporal track, not the spatial discretization: under exact modal evolution the same spatial sequence decreases strictly.
run7's 0.06 s record (2.4 cycles at 40 Hz) adds spectral leakage relative to a coherent window but is not the primary cause (the v2 0.25 s schedule still fails).
